manifestations.description: Persistent pain in right shoulder radiating down the right arm
Aggravated pain when lying on right side, washing or brushing hair with right arm
Could no longer play badminton, swim or dance
Weakness in the right shoulder and arm
Difficulty holding handbag or write longer than 5 minutes; difficulty pouring tea from a teapot and eating with chopsticks with hand extended
Reduced arm movement at elevation, abduction and internal rotation; positive impingement signs
Wasting of shoulder muscles secondary to disuse

treatments_received: Treated at Accident & Emergency Department of Tuen Mun Hospital on the night of the accident and discharged same night
Consulted Dr. Pong Ho Wing (dental surgeon) on 19 June 2006 and received dental treatments; two porcelain crowns made in July 2006
Bonesetter treatments daily from 2 June 2006 until 18 June 2006
Physiotherapy treatments 2 to 3 times a week at MD medical centre
treatments_future: Shoulder arthroscopy operation (recommended by Dr. Ho; defendant's expert considered operation optional)
Follow-up consultations with surgeon (court allowed sum for follow-up consultations)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: She could no longer play badminton, swim or dance.
Persistent shoulder pain and impaired function of the right upper limb; weakness and wasting; assessed impairment (Dr. Ho 13% whole person impairment; Dr. Cheng 6% whole person impairment).

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty combing hair, writing for extended periods, pouring tea and eating with chopsticks with the right hand.
